title: Inhabit

inlines.v: INHAB'IT, verb transitive [Latin inhabito; in and habito, to dwell.] To live or dwell in; to occupy as a place of settled residence. Wild beasts inhabit the forest; fishes inhabit the ocean, lakes and rivers; men inhabit cities and houses. Thus saith the high and lofty One, that inhabiteth eternity--Isaiah 57:15. INHAB'IT, verb intransitive To dwell; to live; to abide. They say wild beasts inhabit here.
